env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build ./...
logos run ./main
stdout '^wire-ok$'
# SPEC 2.5: a const for includes the unexported fields of a T declared in
# the package that defines the generic, here wire, and no others.
stdout '^names-cfg \[Port secret\]$'
stdout '^names-svc \[Port Host\]$'
stdout '^cfg-port 9090$'
stdout '^labels-cfg \[0=Port 1=secret\]$'
stdout '^labels-svc \[0=Port 1=Host\]$'
stdout '^describe-svc struct$'
stdout '^describe-cfg struct$'
stdout '^describe-int scalar$'
stdout '^describe-off silent$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-main.txt
logos run ./names
stdout '^\[Port secret\]$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-names.txt

# SPEC 2.5: each type-argument list compiles to one native instance in the
# package that defines the generic; package main holds no copy.
logos build -gcflags=all=-l -o $WORK/wire.exe ./main
go tool nm $WORK/wire.exe
stdout -count=2 ' T example\.com/wiretest/wire\.Autowire\.logosct\.[0-9a-f]{64}$'
stdout -count=2 ' T example\.com/wiretest/wire\.Names\.logosct\.[0-9a-f]{64}$'
stdout -count=2 ' T example\.com/wiretest/wire\.Labels\.logosct\.[0-9a-f]{64}$'
stdout -count=3 ' T example\.com/wiretest/wire\.Describe\.logosct\.[0-9a-f]{64}$'
! stdout ' T main\..*logosct'

# SPEC 2.5: eject prints Autowire[wire.Config] once, in a generated file of
# package wire, which can set the unexported field secret, so eject succeeds
# and the ejected programs print what the native ones print.
logos eject -o $WORK/out
! stderr 'internal compiler error'
cd $WORK/out
go run ./main
cmp stdout $WORK/native-main.txt
go run ./names
cmp stdout $WORK/native-names.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/wiretest

go 1.27

-- w/wire/wire.lgo --
package wire

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Container struct {
	Port int
	Host string
}

type Config struct {
	Port   int
	secret int
}

func Resolve[T any](c *Container) T {
	var zero T
	switch any(zero).(type) {
	case int:
		return any(c.Port).(T)
	case string:
		return any(c.Host).(T)
	default:
		panic("unresolvable")
	}
}

func Autowire[T any](c *Container) *T {
	var v T
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		v.[f] = Resolve[f.Type](c)
	}
	return &v
}

func Labels[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for i, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("%d=%s", i, f.Name))
	}
	return out
}

func Names[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, f.Name)
	}
	return out
}

const traced = true

const quiet = false

func Describe[T any]() string {
	const if traced && comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return "struct"
	} else const if traced {
		return "scalar"
	}
	return "silent"
}

func DescribeOff[T any]() string {
	const if quiet && comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return "struct"
	} else const if quiet {
		return "scalar"
	}
	return "silent"
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/wiretest/wire"
	"fmt"
)

type Service struct {
	Port   int
	Host   string
	hidden int
}

func main() {
	c := &wire.Container{Port: 9090, Host: "svc"}
	s := wire.Autowire[Service](c)
	if s.Port != 9090 || s.Host != "svc" {
		fmt.Println("BAD", s.Port, s.Host)
		return
	}
	cfg := wire.Autowire[wire.Config](c)
	fmt.Println("wire-ok")
	fmt.Println("names-cfg", wire.Names[wire.Config]())
	fmt.Println("names-svc", wire.Names[Service]())
	fmt.Println("cfg-port", cfg.Port)
	fmt.Println("labels-cfg", wire.Labels[wire.Config]())
	fmt.Println("labels-svc", wire.Labels[Service]())
	fmt.Println("describe-svc", wire.Describe[Service]())
	fmt.Println("describe-cfg", wire.Describe[wire.Config]())
	fmt.Println("describe-int", wire.Describe[int]())
	fmt.Println("describe-off", wire.DescribeOff[Service]())
}

-- w/names/names.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/wiretest/wire"
	"fmt"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(wire.Names[wire.Config]())
}
